title: Vite dev server boots and serves its index
intent: Proves the shortest useful path end to end: install, start a dev server, and reach it through the preview proxy. If this fails, nothing else in the front-end lane can pass.
source: stackblitz-conformance: Vite (public 'Runtime Test Cases for AI Agents' suite, adapted into our own scenario)

steps.purpose: Resolve and install the Vite toolchain
Start the dev server on a fixed port

knownLimits: Reaching the server through the proxy is the harness's job; a proxy miss is HARNESS_BUG, not a runtime failure.
